title: PartitioningResult
description: Schema for the Distributed Training Engine PartitioningResult envelope

datasetId.description: Unique identifier of the partitioned dataset

shards.description: List of descriptors for every generated shard

shardId.description: UUID string uniquely identifying the shard

artifactPath.description: Path to the serialized shard artifact (.pt file)
